nodes.text: 1. Form 3 of Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers-Disclosure scheme will be enabled shortly

2. Due dates for filing of Income Tax Returns and Audit Reports for AY 2026-27 are extended in the cases of persons mentioned at Sl.No.2 in the Table below Explanation2 to Sub-section (1) of Section 139 of Income Tax Act 1961 vide Circular No.07/2026 dated 28th September,2026.
3. Form 1 under the “Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme” is now available for filing.
4. ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4, ITR-5, ITR-6 and ITR-7 for AY 2026-27 are available for filing through both online and offline utilities.
5. Filing of TDS/TCS Correction Statements pertaining to Tax Year 2026-27 has been enabled.

6. Demand Management Facilitation Centre (DFC), has been set up to guide Taxpayers on issues/grievances regarding their outstanding demands. DFC may be contacted through the e-mail id: taxdemand@cpc.incometax.gov.in or on the toll-free number - 1800 309 0131 or chargeable no. 0821-6671200.
7. Excel utilities for filing Updated return for ITR-1 to 7 for AY 2022-23 as per Finance Act, 2026 are available for filing !

A  is a unique identification number issued by the relevant government authority to identify a registered business. It may be used for taxation, regulatory compliance, official records, and business transactions, depending on the applicable jurisdiction.
Provides official recognition of the business.
Supports applicable tax and regulatory requirements.
May be required for business banking and financial services.
Helps establish trust with customers, vendors, and institutions.
May support access to eligible government schemes and incentives.
Can be required for certain tenders, contracts, and commercial transactions.
Requirements vary by jurisdiction and business structure. It may apply to:
Other businesses engaged in commercial activities

– Determine whether BRN registration applies to the business.
– Collect documents based on the business structure.
– Apply through the relevant government authority or portal.
– Complete the prescribed fee payment, where applicable.
– Authorities review the application and supporting documents.
– Receive the Business Registration Number upon approval.
Processing time depends on the jurisdiction, business type, and verification requirements. Applications may take several business days or longer where additional verification is required.
Where BRN registration is mandatory, failure to register may result in penalties, compliance issues, or difficulties with certain banking, licensing, government, or commercial activities.
Where applicable, businesses must renew their registration periodically and update authorities about changes such as business address, ownership, or business structure.
